test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 09 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into active voice?

Couldn’t the cancer be stopped from spreading further by the doctors?

options.text: Couldn’t the doctors stop the cancer from spreading further?
Can’t the doctors stop the cancer from spreading further?
Won’t the doctors stop the cancer from spreading further?
Shouldn’t the doctors stop the cancer from spreading further?

solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Couldn’t the doctors stop the cancer from spreading further?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **passive voice**: "Couldn’t the cancer be stopped from spreading further by the doctors?"
 
• To convert it into the **active voice**, the subject (the doctors) must perform the action.
 
• The sentence structure is adjusted so that the subject comes before the verb, resulting in: "Couldn’t the doctors stop the cancer from spreading further?"
 
• Among the options, **Option 1** is the most accurate conversion of the given sentence into the active voice.

Correct sentence: *Couldn’t the doctors stop the cancer from spreading further?*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Active Voice:** The subject performs the action. Example: "The teacher explained the topic."
 
• **Passive Voice:** The subject receives the action. Example: "The topic was explained by the teacher."
 
• To convert from passive to active voice:
 
 
• Identify the subject, verb, and object.
 
• Rearrange the sentence so the subject performs the action.
 
• Adjust the verb form accordingly.
